strings.(이오가 쓸쓸한 눈빛으로 게르다의 하늘을 바라본다.): (Io gazes at the sky over Gerda with lonely eyes.)
strings.정말 얼마 안 남았구나. 그동안 나는, 우리는 얼마나 이 날을 기다린 걸: It really won't be long now. How long have I... have we been waiting for this day...?
strings.안녕하세요, 이오. 그냥 와봤어요. 지금 오면 안 되는 일이라도 있나요?: Hello, Io. I just thought I'd visit. Is this a bad time?
strings.그건 아닌데, 아직 때가 아니라서. 하여튼, 잘 왔어. 게르다는 언제나: No, it's just that it isn't time yet. Anyway, I'm glad you're here. You're always welcome in Gerda, %s.
You're the reason Medea made up her mind, %s.
strings.별로 없다니…. 겸손도 지나치면 고드름으로 심장을 찔려. 칼리 마을을 계: Not much? Too much modesty will get an icicle through your heart. You kept visiting Kali Village and helping its people without a break...
The goddess is grateful as well.
strings.그런데 크노소스 일 말이야. 어느 정도는 짐작하지만, 그래도 네게 듣고: About Knossos, though. I have some idea, but I'd like to hear it from you... Will you tell me?
strings.(이오에게 크노소스에서 있었던 일을 상세히 이야기한다.): (You tell Io in detail about the events in Knossos.)
If it concerns Medea's people, that witch may be involved too.
strings.…어디까지 내가 도와줄 수 있을진 모르겠지만…, 그건 메디아 양이 해야: ...I don't know how much I can help... It's something Medea must do herself...
strings.아, 저기 마들린에게 고민이 있는 것 같아. 한번 들어보겠어?: Oh, I think something is troubling Madeleine. Would you hear her out?
strings.제가요? 제가 도움이 될까요?: Me? Do you think I can help?
I think talking to you would help her more than talking to me, %s.
In that case, I'll go see her.
strings.혹시 이오 님께서 제 이야기를 하시던가요?: Did Io say something about me?
Sigh... I'll tell you. I don't think you'll leave otherwise...
He keeps appearing in my dreams. It's been difficult.
strings.란다인이에요. 모험가님과는 적이었지만, 저는 다른 의미로 기억하려고 하는: Randine. He was your enemy, but I'm trying to remember him in a different way.
strings.데보라 설원에 전해지는 구전 속엔 신비한 꽃이 있어요. 그 꽃을 찾아 간: An old tale from Deborah Snowfield speaks of a mysterious flower. They say finding it and keeping it close will bring you pleasant dreams.
strings.정말인지 아닌지는 알 수 없지만, 지금 그 꽃을 찾고 있어요. 설원을 다: I don't know if it's true, but I've been looking for it. I've searched the whole snowfield without finding anything like it.
But... I have a feeling it might be in that place I haven't been able to visit...
strings.차마 이오 님께는 말씀드리지 못했어요. 이오 님도 그곳에 다시 간다는 게: I couldn't bring myself to ask Io. Going there again would surely stir up unpleasant memories...
Sigh. I can't believe I'm telling you all this, Adventurer.
It's all right. I'll look for it.
Of course. Wait here for me.
strings.(마들린이 %s에게 전해 받은 꽃을 바라보고 있다.): (Madeleine gazes at the flower %s has brought her.)
A tiny flower inside a piece of ice... It looks as though it could stay there forever.
strings.데보라 설원의 얼음이 특별해서 그런지 몰라도 좀 놀라워요. 전에 메아리의: Maybe it's because the ice of Deborah Snowfield is special, but I'm surprised. I didn't see anything like it when I visited the Echo Spring before.
strings.(내가 발견할 수 있었던 건 이면 안에 있어서였나….): (Was I able to find it because I was on the other side...?)
strings.기분이 좋아졌어요. 이 꽃 때문인지는 모르겠지만, 제 안에 우울했던 뭔가: I feel better. I don't know if it's the flower, but something gloomy inside me seems to have lifted. Perhaps I'll have pleasant dreams now, too?
strings.(마들린이 미소를 짓자 갑자기 손안에 있던 얼음이 녹아버린다.): (As Madeleine smiles, the ice in her hand suddenly melts.)
strings.(아마도 어떤 변화를 겪으면 녹게 되어 있었던 도구였던 것 같은데….): (Perhaps it was made to melt in response to some kind of change...)
strings.(마들린이 손안에 있는 꽃을 조용히 바라본다.): (Madeleine quietly gazes at the flower in her hand.)
strings.이건 데보라 눈꽃이에요. 눈 속에서도 힘겹게 피어올라 예쁜 모습을 보여줘: This is a Deborah Snow Flower. It struggles up through the snow to bloom so beautifully, giving hope and comfort to those who see it.
strings.꽃말도 희망과 위안이니까요…. 데보라의 특별한 얼음과 만났으니 더욱 특별: Hope and comfort are what it symbolizes, too... Together with Deborah's special ice, it must become even more special.
strings.…고마워요, 모험가님. 저는 이제 어느 정도 괜찮아졌는데…, 이오 님은: ...Thank you, Adventurer. I'm feeling somewhat better now... But is Io all right?
strings.언제나 괜찮아, 괜찮아야 해…라고 하시고 마을 사람들을 위해서만 일하세요: She always says, 'I'm fine. I have to be fine,' and works only for the villagers. I wish she'd take care of herself, too...
strings.혹시 저 꽃을 하나만 더 구해주시겠어요?: Could you find just one more of those flowers?
strings.제가 찾아서 이오 님께도 드릴게요. 저도 마침 이오님께 뭔가 드리고 싶었: I'll find one and give it to Io. I'd been wanting to give her something myself, so this works out well.
I'm sorry to trouble you. And thank you.
Now, this flower... Perhaps I could put it in a frame.
